title: A restart recovery degraded by a transient failure (rebind_failed) leaves its session for Resume
outcome: Boot restart recovery that fails with a code-less transport error appends a Degraded rebind_failed card (engram_host_adapter.rs:4345-4355 at be2ed177). Check whether a retained head behind it then needs Resume, and if so retry the recovery on the shared bounded schedule.
acceptance: A discriminating restart regression uses a production-constructed transient transport failure and a persisted, acknowledged, never-begun admission retry head. It records the original boot-recovery result and determines whether the head recovers automatically or remains stranded; no fabricated code-less error or failing assertion is used to force a reproduction.

After transient boot-rebind failure, the same retained prompt recovers without Resume or a new prompt using the existing durable, idempotent retry schedule and shared bound; verification shows at most one provider delivery, no admission before recovery authority is ready, and retention across another restart.

Verification preserves explicit Stop or operator pause, cancellation, changed authority, definitive configuration errors and possibly-begun grant reconciliation. A transient recovery does not bypass these holds, reset the shared first-held bound or introduce a second recovery mechanism.

The full maintained five-stage gate passes on the exact landed input if a source or test changeset is needed. If the discriminating check confirms existing behavior, the item records that causal evidence and coordinator concurrence on a no-change disposition instead of inventing a product repair.
